judged_text: The public GET /groups/:name/members response shape changed from a bare serialized array to a {members: [...], meta: {...}} envelope with no versioning or compatibility period. Out-of-tree API consumers and scripts parsing the old array response read result[0].username off an object and get undefined, producing empty or incorrect output under a 200 status.

adjudication.rationale: The diff clearly changes `GroupsController#members` from `render_serialized(members.to_a, GroupUserSerializer)` (which would return a bare array) to `render json: { members: ..., meta: ... }` (an envelope) at `GET /groups/:group_id/members` (now requested as `/members.json` from the JS). There is no compatibility shim (e.g., supporting both shapes) or versioning indicated in the diff, so external consumers expecting an array could break as described. This is a real, diff-grounded backward-compatibility/API-contract concern, not an internal correctness bug in the updated client code.
